success.H1: fewer healthy interventions AND fewer measured search calls
success.H2: no decrease in recovered cases OR mean failing nDCG; zero healthy regressions over epsilon
success.H3: all labeled failures have zero results

change_reason: Measured candidate generation latency is sunk diagnostic cost, not predicted future repair cost; separate selection inputs from measurement.
expected_cost_scope: Selection model: declared external usage of offline typed patch; future latency uncalibrated/null and excluded via zero weight. Actual searches, reindexes and wall-clock remain measured separately.
reproducibility_contract: Same observation/candidate content/expected cost/config yields same decision regardless of measured diagnostic latency.
